advancement.erebus.agriculture/ant_amule: Craft the Ant Taming Amulet and tame an Ant.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/bamboo.de: Get your hands on some Colossal Bamboo and Colossal Bamboo Shoots.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/bee_amule: Fashion a Bee Taming Amulet from some Jade and Nectar.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/beecon.de: Use the Nectar you procured to craft a Homing Beecon, a device that allows you to always find your way back.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/beetle_br: Get two Beetles in the mood by feeding them the most erotic of vegetables - to them at least, we don't judge.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/honey.des: Use the Nectar you obtained to create Honey.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/honeyfood: Prepare yourself a wonderful meal by crafting all Honey-related foods.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/nectar.de: Obtain some Nectar by asking some Bees with the blade of your weapon.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/root.desc: Even though the sun does not shine down here, there are still many plants and other growables to be found. Dive into the wonderful world of subterranean agriculture!
advancement.erebus.agriculture/silo.desc: Craft the three parts of the Silo multiblock.
advancement.erebus.agriculture/spoon.des: Craft a Nectar Collector, a simple yet ingenious tool to easily collect Nectar from Bees.
advancement.erebus.exploration/antivenom: Brew some Anti-venom in the Smoothie Maker.
Gather all the different saplings of trees native to the Erebus.
advancement.erebus.exploration/beetledri: Down an entire Bambucket of Beetle Juice. Yes, you heard that right.
advancement.erebus.exploration/beetlejui: Milk a Beetle to obtain Beetle Juice, the Erebus counterpart to milk.
advancement.erebus.exploration/entomolog: Slay a creature native to the Erebus.
advancement.erebus.exploration/exo_set.d: Obtain all four pieces of the Exoskeleton armour set and the Exoskeleton Shield.
advancement.erebus.exploration/find_beet: Have a somewhat unkind encounter with any of the Beetles or their Larvae.
What Shade of Green Is This?
Obtain all four pieces of the Jade armour set and the Jade Paxel.
Kill all regular mobs the Erebus has to offer.
advancement.erebus.exploration/newspaper: Enhance some Papyrus with Ink and Whetstone Powder to roll a newspaper with extreme swatting capabilities.
advancement.erebus.exploration/petrified: Craft a Petrified Wood Chest, an expensive but more spaceous chest.
advancement.erebus.exploration/planticid: Mix together some Planticide to destroy some flora.
advancement.erebus.exploration/poison_sa: Snag a Poison Sac from the innards of one of the many venomous critters that inhabit the Erebus.
advancement.erebus.exploration/quicksand: Get yourself stuck in some Quicksand.
advancement.erebus.exploration/reinexo_s: Obtain all four pieces of the Reinforced Exoskeleton armour set and the Reinforced Exoskeleton Shield.
Truth Is... I Am Exo Man
advancement.erebus.exploration/repellent: Get your hands on some Repellent.
advancement.erebus.exploration/rhino_bee: Kill the Rhinoceros Beetle and obtain its exoskeleton and horn.
advancement.erebus.exploration/rhino_exo: Craft the entire Rhino Plate set, including the shield.
advancement.erebus.exploration/root.desc: Travel to a long lost world, overrun by gargantuan arthropods: The Erebus.
advancement.erebus.exploration/smoothie_: Craft the ErebusCo. Smoothie-matic 2000, all rights reserved.
Get the smoothie guide book by right-clicking the Smoothie-matic 2000 with a blank book.
advancement.erebus.exploration/stung.des: Get stung by a Wasp or a Scorpion.
advancement.erebus.exploration/stung.tit: The Boy with the Thorn in His Side
advancement.erebus.exploration/titan_bee: Slay a Titan Beetle and obtain its flesh.
advancement.erebus.exploration/titan_ste: Cook yourself some Titan Stew, the most nourishing meal you'll ever eat.
advancement.erebus.exploration/traveller: Travel to all biomes the Erebus has to offer.
advancement.erebus.exploration/water_rep: Acquire some Hydrofuge to craft Water Repellent.
advancement.erebus.exploration/whetstone: Get your hands on some Whetstone Powder and apply it to an unenchanted Whetstone.
advancement.erebus.exploration/woodlouse: Catch a Woodlouse by right-clicking it with an empty hand.
advancement.erebus.portal/altar.title: Contacting the Gods
advancement.erebus.portal/gaean_gem.desc: Offer a Diamond, an Emerald and a piece of Obsidian on the Offering Altar and obtain the Gaean Gem.
advancement.erebus.portal/portal.desc: Construct the Erebus portal by placing any type of leaf blocks in a frame and activate it by inserting the Staff of Gaea into the Gaean Keystone near it.
advancement.erebus.portal/portal.title: Constructing the Gate
advancement.erebus.portal/portal_activat: Obtain the Staff of Gaea and the Gaean Keystone.
advancement.erebus.portal/root.desc: A world below our own, ready to be accessed...
advancement.erebus.portal/root.title: The Portal
erebus.book.smoothie.0:
§0Thank you for using the new ErebusCo. Smoothie-matic 2000.
In the following pages you will find some delicious recipes.

Each recipe will require a different base fluid. The fluid bars shown in the gui are for: Honey, Beetle Juice, Anti-Venom and Milk.
erebus.book.smoothie.1:
§0Fluids can be added to the Smoothie-matic 2000 by right clicking on the block with a full bucket.

The Four top slots in the gui are for the required ingredients and the lower slot must contain a Smoothie Glass.

tooltip.erebus.ant_taming_amulet_1: Click on a Silo Block to set as target for Ants.
tooltip.erebus.ant_taming_amulet_2: Then click on Ant to link it.
tooltip.erebus.bamboo_pipe: A very basic directional fluid pipe.
tooltip.erebus.bamboo_pipe_extract: Extracts fluids from fluid containers and pushes them in to pipes and fluid containers.
tooltip.erebus.bamboo_pipe_wrench: Use on any Bamboo Pipe to rotate them or Use + Sneak to insta-break them.
tooltip.erebus.bee_taming_amulet_1: Click on a Honeycomb Cell to set as target for Bee drops.
tooltip.erebus.bee_taming_amulet_2: Then click on Bee to tame.
tooltip.erebus.death_compass: Given to Player after death to find Block o' Bones.
tooltip.erebus.extractor: Point at blocks and hold down the right mouse button to extract them.
tooltip.erebus.feeds: Fills Hunger Bar when consumed. Always Edible.
tooltip.erebus.glow_gem: Place on ANY side of a solid block as a light source. Right click to turn off and on.
tooltip.erebus.healing_hearts: Heals you a small amount when consumed.
tooltip.erebus.heals: Heals 10 Hearts when consumed. Always Edible.
tooltip.erebus.homingbeecon: Sneak + Click on a block to set as target.
tooltip.erebus.homingbeecon_advanced_1: Sneak + Right click on a block to set as target.
tooltip.erebus.jump_boots: Enables you to Jump 4 blocks high.
tooltip.erebus.liquifier: Turns Honey Drips in to Fluid Honey. Redstone activated.
tooltip.erebus.mush_helm: Keeps you fed whilst worn at the cost of durability. Repaired in Anvil with Big Mushroom Blocks.
tooltip.erebus.nectar_collector: Right click Bees or Honeypot Ants to collect nectar.
tooltip.erebus.night_vision: Enables you to see in the dark.
tooltip.erebus.planticide: Removes Plants, Leaves and Crops in a 4x4x4 area!
tooltip.erebus.powered_glider: Needs redgem blocks at the cost of fuel to flight.
tooltip.erebus.quake_hammer_1: Hold Right mouse button to charge up.
tooltip.erebus.quake_hammer_2: Sneak + Right Click on top of block to use A.O.E. attack.
tooltip.erebus.scorpion_pincer: Can Shoot Fire Charges if in your Inventory.
tooltip.erebus.spray_can: Use on the top of blocks to keep those pesky critters away.
tooltip.erebus.wand_of_animation: Right click blocks to animate them.
tooltip.erebus.wand_of_preservation: Shoots Amber stars and captures mobs. Silk touch the block to collect or break to free the mob.
tooltip.erebus.water_striders: Enables you to Walk on Water.
tooltip.erebus.web_slinger: Can Shoot Webs if in your Inventory.
tooltip.erebus.whetstone_1: Apply to tools using an Anvil.
tooltip.erebus.whetstone_3: Surround with Whetstone Powder to increase levels.
